$comment: Pins the unit-openapi spec version the committed SDKs were generated from. The dispatch-driven regeneration PR bumps `version`; `fetch-spec` downloads the matching bundled spec. Keep this in sync with the spec/openapi.json `info.version` in the unit-openapi repo. `slices` is derived automatically by `fetch-spec` from the materialized spec's tags — do not edit by hand. When the spec is materialized from a local file or URL rather than the pinned release, `fetch-spec` also syncs `version` from the spec's own `info.version`.
